text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock B and other positions at gains while my account value still fell overall; I should judge each trade by its future prospects and portfolio impact, not the pleasure of locking in a gain.","I should not treat each stock as a separate account or let its average cost dictate my decision. A loss is not a reason by itself to hold, just as a gain is not a reason by itself to sell.","Checking prices daily and trading often can encourage reactive decisions. I will use a consistent plan, consider diversification and risk, and avoid trading without a clear reason."]}
